gonna win.

text_block_list.text:
Emergency! No, no, that topic is strictly 
off-limits right now~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, I want you to look only at 
Maya!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Even if you say that, y you 
still totally <color=#ff007f>Maya☆Love</color> me... right?! 
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey! Next time, I'm definitely 
taking 1st place in the race!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... I'll definitely make everyone 
think Maya is way more amazing than the 
other girls!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever! Next time, I'm 
absolutely, definitely gonna run an 
amazing race!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'm gonna make everyone realize 
Maya's the cutest and most charming woman 
of all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All's fair in love and war, bring it on!!
